DECLARE
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN

 IF :SYSTEM.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT','CHANGED') THEN

 FROM valid_tests_don
 WHERE test_id = :valid_tests.test_id;

 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DUP_RECORD_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE dup_record_check IS
 counter NUMBER;
 chk NUMBER;
BEGIN
 if :global.test_id != :valid_tests.test_id then /* new check */
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C10',:global.test_id||
 ',','D',chk); 
 end if;
if :valid_tests.test_id is not null then
 SELECT COUNT(*)
 INTO counter
 FROM valid_tests_don
 WHERE test_id = :valid_tests.test_id;
 if :system.record_status = 'INSERT' then 
 if counter > 0 then 
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else 
 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C10',:valid_tests.test_id||
 ',','U',chk); 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 end if;

 if :system.record_status = 'CHANGED' then
 if counter > 1 then
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 else


 check_insert_rg('CRG_VALID','C10',:valid_tests.test_id||
 ',','U',chk); 
 
 IF chk >= 1 THEN
 BELL;
 --MESSAGE('Err. Duplicate Record Entry.');
 --RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 show_error('0319');
 END IF;
 end if;
 END IF; /* record status check end*/
end if; /* 1st if then */
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

PROCEDURE validate_eff_term_dates ( eff_date in date,
 term_date in date,
 from_where in varchar2 ) 
IS
dt_chk boolean;
begin
 if eff_date is null then
 show_error('5002');
 end if;
 if eff_date < trunc(sysdate) and from_where = 'E' then
 show_error('5015');
 end if;

 if term_date is not null then
 if term_date < trunc(sysdate) then
 show_error('3115');
 end if;
 dt_chk := check_from_to_date(eff_date,term_date);
 if dt_chk then
 null;
 else
 --message('Err. Term date is before effective date.');
 --raise form_trigger_failure;
 show_error('5004');
 end if;
 end if;
end;
